newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japan's JCR upgrades Manila to investment grade.
newsitem.headline: Japan's JCR upgrades Manila to investment grade.

text.p: Japan Credit Rating Agency Ltd (JCR) had upgraded its rating on the Philippines to Triple B, an investment grade, from Triple B minus, the Department of Finance said on Monday.

"The latest credit rating upgrade given to the Philippines is another testimony of the continued confidence of the international financial community to the economic programme of President (Fidel) Ramos," Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said in a statement.
He said the upgrade would translate to more foreign investments not only from Japan but from other investing countries such as the United States and European nations.

"The credit rating upgrade broadens the country's access to long-term foreign capital that can help the national government meet the infrastructure requirements of sustainable economic development with the active participation of the private sector and local government units," Finance Undersecretary Cecilia Soriano said in the same statement.

Two international credit rating agencies, Standard & Poor's and Moody's Investors Service, upgraded their rating of the Philippines to one notch below investment grade earlier this year. -- Manila Newsroom (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
